lemmas.name: sort_ok
lemmas.statement: ∀ (l : List Int), (∀ i, i < (l.mergeSort (fun a b => decide (a ≤ b))).length - 1 → (l.mergeSort (fun a b => decide (a ≤ b)))[i]! ≤ (l.mergeSort (fun a b => decide (a ≤ b)))[i + 1]!) ∧ (l.mergeSort (fun a b => decide (a ≤ b))).isPerm l = true
lemmas.proof:
by intro l
  have hp : (l.mergeSort (fun a b => decide (a ≤ b))).Perm l := List.mergeSort_perm l _
  refine ⟨?_, List.isPerm_iff.mpr hp⟩
  intro i hi
  have hs : List.Pairwise (fun a b => decide (a ≤ b) = true) (l.mergeSort (fun a b => decide (a ≤ b))) :=
    List.pairwise_mergeSort (by intro a b c h1 h2; simp at *; omega) (by intro a b; simp; omega) l
  rw [List.pairwise_iff_getElem] at hs
  have hi' : i + 1 < (l.mergeSort (fun a b => decide (a ≤ b))).length := by omega
  have := hs i (i + 1) (by omega) hi' (by omega)
  rw [getElem!_pos _ i (by omega), getElem!_pos _ (i + 1) hi']
  simpa using this
